newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil prems and futures steady in dull day.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil prems and futures steady in dull day.

text.p: NWE spot gas oil was slow on Monday with futures trading in a very narrow range and premiums showing little movement, traders said.
May IPE gas oil closed 25 cents higher at $166.00 a tonne.
Traders said diesel still held its firm tone from last week with cargo bids heard around May IPE +13.50 cif NWE, but with no real offers.

"Its a quiet Monday that has a couple of key players out of the market - that is what is making it so dull," said one trader. Heating oil cargoes were pegged unchanged at May IPE +$4-5 cif NWE for FOD and a touch more for DIN.
Heating oil barges were very quiet with dealers complaining about the lacklustre demand, particuarly from Germany.
"Hopefully it will get better in May, it should do," said one.
Heating barges were heard at May IPE +75 cents for refinery material with storage at screen flat or lower.
A 1-2,000 tonne Antwerp barge was sold at flat.
